Alex Chen: Heads-up: external assessor (SecFirm) is scheduled to start 2024-09-17. Need final RBAC window, KMS access model, and audit export path locked down by EOD Thurs. Who owns the evidence envelope? :wave:
Maria Gomez: I can own intake + evidence envelope. Propose RBAC window 2024-09-17 10:00-18:00 UTC. Need two people oncall with rollback rights.
Sam Peters: I can be oncall for the window. What is the minimal role set we grant to assessors?
Maria Gomez: Minimal: read-only on infra resources, read metadata for secrets (no key access). We'll provision an ephemeral "assessor" role via KMS-proxy. No direct key export allowed. Use presigned S3 for logs/audit.
Priya Nair: We also need to allowlist SecFirm CIDR in the VPC peering rules for the window. Prefer to apply RBAC changes via terraform plan -> apply during the pre-window slot so we can rollback quickly.
Luis Ortega: I can prepare the terraform plan. Quick Q on KMS: do they need decrypt-as-service (KMS proxy) or temporary grants to a service account? Their tooling might try to decrypt sample blobs.
Maria Gomez: Policy is explicit: no key material export, no service accounts with persistent decrypt. Use KMS proxy (decrypt-as-service). We'll provide a couple of test blobs that are intentionally reversible via the proxy.
Alex Chen: For audit logs, we want continuous capture for the window + 72h post-test. Where should these exports land and who's on ingestion?
Priya Nair: Send exports to s3://redwood-pt-exports/secfirm-20240917/. Lifecycle 90 days. Set up Firehose ingestion to SIEM; I'll add grant to the firehose role for the KMS key.
Sam Peters: Retest cadence question — if they find medium/high issues, do we target a 2-week remediation sprint and then a retest window? Propose retro 48h after report + retest slot planned within 14 days.
Maria Gomez: Agreed. Also require threat-model owner sign-off before scheduling retest. I'll create a checklist in the evidence envelope: RBAC rollback checked, evidence pack uploaded, mitigation PR IDs included, test-case re-runs noted.
Luis Ortega: I'll attach the terraform diff + PR links into the envelope and tag PRs like `pt-fix/ISSUE-123`. Also will add a small README with commands we used for smoke verification.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled ephemeral role creation at 2024-09-17T09:50Z for assessor run. Command: `/create-ephemeral --role=assessor --duration=8h --auditor=secfirm@example.com`
Alex Chen: Can we run a dry-run Tuesday to smoke-test ephemeral roles, presigned export, and KMS-proxy decrypt flow?
Priya Nair: Tuesday 2024-09-10 15:00 UTC works for the dry-run. I'll run the smoke checklist and post logs (trimmed) to the envelope.
Maria Gomez: I'll collect assessor contacts and intake form today, then populate the envelope template. Assigning ownership: Maria (intake & envelope), Priya (network & export pipeline), Luis (infra PRs + terraform diffs), Sam (oncall & rollback).
Alex Chen: Thanks — please also update the incident runbook with a new `assessor-handshake` section covering ephemeral role creation, presigned-export location, and KMS-proxy usage.
Sam Peters: One more: add a short rollback playbook snippet to the envelope: steps to revoke ephemeral roles, restore previous terraform state, and confirm SIEM log continuity.
Maria Gomez: Will do. I'll post the final envelope link and the dry-run notes after Tuesday. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup:
